stem.text: The driver of a car applies two parallel forces to a steering wheel, as shown.

stem.alt: Steering wheel viewed from the front with two forces, each labelled 15 N and marked at 65°, a label for the centre of the steering wheel, and a dimension labelled 0.40 m across the wheel.

stem.text: Each force has a magnitude of $15\,\text{N}$ and acts in the direction shown. The steering wheel has a diameter of $0.40\,\text{m}$.
What is the torque exerted on the steering wheel?
